title: Power Rankings: Magic miss playoffs, but make Top 10
heading: 2005-06 Power Rankings: Week 24

rankings.summaryHtml: Climbing from the depths of 20-40? The possibility of a 9-0 April? Playoffs or not, Grant Hill is so geeked to play with these kids that he's talking comeback again.

rankings.summaryHtml: Brent Barry is right when he says all the doom and gloom surrounding Spurs is a bit much, because they can still secure the best record in club history with a 2-0 finish.

rankings.summaryHtml: Mavs probably have to win the West for Nowitzki to be MVP. But to win in the playoffs, Dallas' key might be Josh Howard, since Mavs are 19-0 when he scores at least 20.

rankings.summaryHtml: Back-to-back playoff berths for the first time since 1988 is nice. Winning one more game to ensure that the East won't have four sub-.500 playoff teams is better.
